description.en: The end of the time range for the statistics.

description.zh: 资源组ID，唯一标识客户的资源组（机器组）。
description.en: The ID of the resource group (machine group).
The start of the time range for the statistics.

description.zh: 工作空间ID列表，多个ID间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: The IDs of workspaces. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,). For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).

descriptions.zh: 输入用户的工作空间ID和资源组ID，以及统计时间区间，就可获取在指定工作空间和资源组下DSW实例运行状态统计数据。
descriptions.en: You can specify workspace IDs, a resource group ID, and a time range to retrieve statistics about the running status of DSW instances in the specified workspaces and resource group.
